title: Basic arithmetic of a normalized discrete valuation
statement: Let v:K^\times\to\mathbf Z be the normalized valuation of a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field K. For nonzero a,b\in K, v(ab)=v(a)+v(b), v(a^N)=Nv(a) for every integer N>0, and if v(a)\ne v(b) then v(a+b)=\min(v(a),v(b)).
